get.summary: The bookable times of a service
get.description: Public. Give `date` (one day) or `from` and `to` (up to 31 days), as calendar dates in the service's own time zone (`time_zone` in the answer). Each slot has `starts_at` / `ends_at` as ISO-8601 with the service's UTC offset: send `starts_at` back unchanged to book it. A slot says how many seats are left and, when it cannot be booked, why (`full`, `provider_busy`, `too_soon`, `too_far`). Slots already count the bookings that hold a place (pending, confirmed, in progress, cancellation requested; an unpaid booking only until its hold ends) and the provider's other bookings. `timezone` (optional, IANA) adds `starts_at_display` in that zone. `provider_id` and `delivery_mode` only check that the service offers them.

post.description: FR-PAY-01. Names what is bought (`cart_order`, `event_order`, or a `custom` payment a business asks a customer to make); the amount is read from the order, never from the request. Returns the payment and `checkout`, what the gateway's SDK needs. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a repeated request returns the same payment. A customer who comes back to an unpaid payment for the same order gets that payment again.

post.summary: Verify a payment with the gateway
post.description: FR-PAY-02, FR-PAY-11. Send what the browser / app got back from the gateway (Razorpay: razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature; Stripe: payment_intent_id or nothing; test gateway: test_token). The signature is checked and the gateway's own answer decides. Safe to call again. `requires_action` means 3-D Secure / OTP is still to be done: call again after it. If the gateway does not answer, the payment becomes `processing` and is checked automatically.
post.x-stage: existing route; target contract subject to review

post.summary: Ask for a refund, or refund a payment
post.description: FR-REF-01, FR-REF-02. A customer's request waits for the business (or platform) to approve it. When the business or platform refunds, it is approved and sent to the gateway at once. Leave `amount` out for a full refund of what is left. A credit note, the tax reversal and the order update follow when it completes.
